finding: Blender 5.2.2 GLB export with ACTIONS includes the unselected original BMD action_1 (eight clips). NLA_TRACKS exports only the seven HD tracks, but in reverse list order (06..00).
guidance: For a GLB scene containing BMD reference plus HD candidate, export selected HD armature/LODs with export_animation_mode=NLA_TRACKS. Validate exactly seven named clips, map them to MU action indices by name rather than array order, and compare animation samples after round-trip.
